title: LG-CUBICPACK171: explicit live-owner census and linear-width component rows improve the cubic exact polynomial factors

claims.statement: For every N>=2 and secret s, n=ceil(log2 N), the ONE fixed physical LG-CUBICPACK171 implementation in proof.md executes the complete unchanged cubic virtual source supplied in virtual.md, with its finite tester for n<2^60,otherwise z=ceil(cuberoot(n)),f=32,w=floor(3249z²/10000),y=ceil(499z/5000),Hb=ceil(23378749z²/4990000),Ybar=z,K=8192(3z+ceilLogn+30),the cumulative batch-source guardCcap and original local guards/conservative nominalLEcap. The ACTUAL physical capacities are A=2^16*n,R=2^128*n^16*2^w,Wrow=2^16*n,H=2^64*n^16*2^w,with actual512-position component records,full original field/array domains,additional raw type descriptors,generation width e=16z² bits and exact finite overflow repair. The unconditional ENTIRE-secret success is at least1-2^-8 from independent ideal copies. Jointly on EVERY branch T=O(n^60*2^((23378749/4990000)n^(2/3)+(12311877/1247500)n^(1/3))),ordinary S_C=O(n),full allocated S_Q=O(n^(56/3)*2^((3249/10000)n^(2/3)+(3249/5000)n^(1/3))),and total Q=O(n^2*2^((499/1000)n^(1/3))). All failures,rejections,discards,partial attempts,guards,retries,aborts,initialization,full physical address debits,source transfers,lifecycle actions,finite exact epoch repair and cleanup count with exact displayed coefficients/powers and absolute outside constants. This resource is total work,with exact growth index2/3.
